prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person in a long-sleeved purple crop top and white shorts"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09", "P10", "P11", "P12"].

message.content: {"matches":["P09"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"Only P09 is visibly wearing a long-sleeved purple crop top and white shorts in both crops. Other individuals wear purple tops with different sleeve lengths (e.g., short-sleeved) or different bottoms (e.g., pants, skirts). P01 wears a long-sleeved purple top but with matching purple pants, not white shorts. P11 and P12 wear short-sleeved purple tops with white shorts. P03 and P04 wear white tops with purple bottoms. No other person matches all specified clothing attributes."}

parsed.reason: Only P09 is visibly wearing a long-sleeved purple crop top and white shorts in both crops. P01 wears a long-sleeved purple top but with matching purple pants, not white shorts. P11 and P12 wear short-sleeved purple tops with white shorts. P03 and P04 wear white tops with purple bottoms. No other person matches all specified clothing attributes.
